title: hedyotis ovalis
intro: Hedyotis ovalis, commonly known as Bu Gu Zhi or Chinese Rubyrth, is a traditional Chinese medicinal plant that belongs to the family Rubiaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure, improve blood circulation, and alleviate symptoms of insomnia and anxiety. The therapeutic actions of Hedyotis ovalis include its anti-inflammatory, anti-oxidative, and adaptogenic properties, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Hedyotis ovalis include iridoid glycosides, phenolic acids, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
